probius: Warp In Pylon (trait) before you push or fight: you only regen mana inside its Power Field and it powers your Photon Cannon walls. Place it, then commit.
qhira: Grappling Hook (trait) to engage: hitting an enemy launches and kicks them. Aim at terrain behind a target to reposition, or use it to escape over walls.
ragnaros: Molten Core (trait) on an allied or destroyed Fort/Keep for burst siege or teamfight tempo; it burns away in ~18s, so pop it when it swings the moment.
rehgar: Purge (trait) your carry the instant they get stunned, rooted, or dived: the 0.5s Unstoppable breaks the CC. On an enemy it is an 80% slow to peel.
rexxar: Misha, Focus! (trait): send Misha to body-block skillshots, soak abilities, or lock onto a diving assassin; target Rexxar to recall her when she is low.
sgthammer: Siege Mode (trait) when safe and stationary for +100% range and splash to melt structures or clumped enemies; exit it the moment you must reposition.
stitches: Shambling Horror (trait) as you dive: 4s of slow-immunity plus Vile Gas, so Hook and Slam through the enemy team while they cannot kite you.
stukov: Bio-Kill Switch (trait): hold it so Healing Pathogen ticks first, but detonate on demand for the Weighted Pustule damage and 75% slow to secure a kill.
sylvanas: Black Arrows (trait) before hitting a merc camp, structures, or the core: 10s of your attacks stunning non-Heroes lets you capture and backdoor uncontested.
tassadar: Resonance Beam (trait): keep your Basic Attack channeled on one target to ramp damage and mana up to +100%; do not drop the beam or the charge resets.
tracer: Reload (trait) manually behind cover or after a Blink so you are never caught mid-reload in a fight; time it during downtime, not while a kill is in range.
tychus: Minigun (trait) right as a fight starts and stay on the highest-Health target: it adds 2.5% of their max Health per hit for 3s, so uptime on tanks is huge.
tyrael: Archangel's Wrath (trait): when you die your corpse drifts and explodes after 4s, so steer it into the enemy team for 450 burst and a faster respawn.
tyrande: Hunter's Mark (trait) on the kill target just before your team commits: the -15 Armor and reveal amplify all follow-up burst for 4s.
uther: Devotion (trait): even dead you enter spirit form; bait the enemy onto your body, then keep landing Holy Lights and Armor before you fade.
valeera: Vanish (trait) to open or reset a fight: it restealths and refreshes your combo openers, so stack combo points then burst a squishy from cloak.
whitemane: Zeal (trait): pop the +25% Spell Power (costs 15 Armor) during your damage window while allies hold Zeal, so your burst heals them for 100% of it.
yrel: Divine Purpose (trait) to instantly fire a normally-charged Basic Ability at no mana: use it to guarantee a Righteous Hammer stun or an escape when caught.
zagara: Creep Tumor (trait): seed tumors for map vision and +20% Move Speed on Creep; drop one before objectives or to watch flanks, and keep charges banked.
zarya: Bubble (Energy, trait) the engage target BEFORE their burst lands to build Energy, then dump your charged Particle Grenade damage: shield timing IS your damage.
zeratul: Permanent Cloak (trait): stay out of combat to restealth and stand still 1.5s to go Invisible; approach unseen and pick your engage angle before you strike.
zuljin: Berserker (trait): toggle on for +25% Attack Damage when you can trade safely, but it drains 2% max Health per hit, so keep lifesteal or sustain up.
